title: Model Reliability & Accuracy
method: 5-fold cross-validation on 832 real-world photos (746 PlantDoc field photos + 86 of our own phone photos). Every photo was tested once by a model that had not seen it.

runs.name: + PlantDoc & own photos (fine-tuned 1)
runs.trainedOn: Roboflow + Mendeley, then PlantDoc + own photos

runs.name: + PlantDoc & own photos, with replay (fine-tuned 2)
runs.trainedOn: Roboflow + Mendeley, then PlantDoc + own photos with 540 replay photos

kappaMeaning: Moderate agreement on real-world photos (Landis & Koch scale). Kappa shows how much better the model is than guessing: 0 is chance, 1 is perfect.
caveat: Field photos are much harder than dataset photos. On the original Roboflow test photos, this model still scores 99.32% (6 of 883 wrong). Bacterial spot and mosaic virus are the weakest on field photos, so treat low-confidence results with care.
